title: What must future work preserve?
question: Primary audiences are confirmed: people continuing verified in-person connections, and venue/promoter operators on Click for Business. Neither is a side quest. Which product facts are inviolable for click-web? (Use the note if something below is wrong or missing.)

options.label: Presence over the feed
options.thesis: Click exists to turn verified in-person encounters into lasting connection — not to recreate a scroll loop on the web.
options.body: Preserve: no ads, no infinite feed, 48-hour archive as hygiene not punishment. Web cannot fake Tri-Factor or Multi-Tap. Insights may only claim verified cliques and anonymized topology. Do not invent testimonials, ROI numbers, or customers. Landing stays honest: handshake → friendship, built at UW.
options.case: Matches README, landing, and mobile product thesis.

options.label: Prove who showed up together
options.thesis: The inviolable job is operator proof: verified factions, sticky score, vibe radar — still no fake graphs, but consumer calmness is secondary to operator clarity.
options.body: Preserve handshake integrity in the data. Design pressure sits on Insights: heatmaps, tribes, beacons, events engagement. Consumer dashboard stays correct and quiet rather than campaign-led.
options.case: Still two-sided, but success is cited community ROI for venues.

options.label: Web as a true companion
options.thesis: The inviolable job is that a person can continue the relationship on the web with parity where hardware is not required.
options.body: Preserve chat/E2EE, LiveKit, map, events, QR, connections inbox. Insights stays truthful but is not the success definition. Still no feed, still no fabricated proof.
options.case: Matches the parity matrix: yes for post-connection, no for sensors.

options.label: Correct the thesis
options.thesis: The repo framing is stale or incomplete — tell us what actually must be preserved.
options.body: Use the note. Examples: positioning has changed, launch state matters more than thesis, legal/brand constraints not in the repo, a third audience, or a capability we must not claim.
options.case: Choose this if any recommended fact would be wrong in PRODUCT.md.
